exclusions.source_line: The owner reports a 4 × 5 ft live area (approximately 1,219 × 1,524 mm) and a V1 Jackpot controller. They said the first two cuts covered the machine's cost because a current prop project otherwise would have required outsourcing CNC work. The owner makes sets and props, and described the machine as taking on much of the CNC work they had previously paid shops to do. This is an owner-reported business outcome, not a measured machine capability or accuracy test.
